title: [Safety] Stopping insulin delivery logs carbs which then triggers delivery
symptom: When a user cancels bolusing after entering carbs in the bolus wizard, the carbs are logged even though no insulin was delivered. Later, entering carbs again results in a bolus for COB plus new carbs, potentially delivering double the intended amount.
cause: In previous versions, carbs were logged even if the bolus was not successful, which could lead to double dosing if the user re-enters carbs.
fix: In the current version, carbs are not logged if the bolus is not successful. The maintainer states: 'in current version carbs are not logged if bolus is not successful (in oposition to previous versions)'.
evidence_quote: in current version carbs are not logged if bolus is not successful (in oposition to previous versions)
